notes.title: 1.0.5 Update is now Live !
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the v1.0.5 Update is now live on Steam !
Features :
- Add a new volume option for the music
- Add a new volume option for the sound effects
- Add a rebinding controls option
- Add an "Immortal" feature in the options
- Add Portuguese language support
